newsitem.title: USA: NZ SPORT-Nobilo finishes 29th after shocker back 9.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-Nobilo finishes 29th after shocker back 9.

text.p: MAMARONECK, New York, Aug 17 - Frank Nobilo's hopes of grabbing a top-five finish in the US PGA dried up under the blazing sun when the New Zealander finished a distant 29th at the Winged Foot Golf Club.
The final day and the last major of the year belonged to American Davis Love III, who won by five shots from compatriot Justin Leonard.

A fighting third round three-under 67 -- after early rounds of 72 and 73 -- raised the promise of a strong finish from Nobilo and that was justified when the Aucklander rattled off three birdies in succession from the fourth to sixth holes.
That put Nobilo's score back to even-par after starting the day at two-over.
However, a disastrous back nine, which included six bogeys, set the tone as Nobilo trudged from the course at the end of his round accompanied by a downpour of rain.
"I tried to do my best after getting it to a couple under on the front nine but the back nine was just horrible," Nobilo said.
"I'm disappointed to finish the way I did and that's about all I can say."
It was the first major title for the 33-year-old Love, and his 11th tour title since turning professional in 1986.
Nobilo was quickly on a flight back to his Orlando home to take stock of his next event, the World Series of Golf in Ohio.
That tournament, starting on Thursday, features an exclusive 45-player field where there is no halfway cut and last place is guaranteed at least $US20,000 ($NZ31,500).
